MDL materials, pedestrian hair materials discovered
Peak shader permutations across all feature levels/platforms

QUEUE_GROWTH_CAUSE: Recursive dependency discovery during cook expands the material set exponentially. Each new package (mesh, blueprint, material instance) adds shader permutations for ALL targeted shader platforms (PCD3D_SM5, SF_VULKAN_SM5, PCD3D_ES31) and feature levels. The -cooksinglepackage flag does not limit shader scope.

CORRELATION_FACTORS.package_discovery: Direct correlation: package count 1778->3553 correlates with shader queue 428->8227
CORRELATION_FACTORS.new_materials: Each new master material (M_RoadMasterTiled, M_DHair_MASTER, gltf_material, M_Building_Master, etc.) adds 10-50+ permutations
CORRELATION_FACTORS.feature_levels: 3 feature levels (SM5, Vulkan SM5, ES3_1) multiply permutations 3x
CORRELATION_FACTORS.material_permutations: Quality levels, lighting modes, vertex factories multiply base shaders
CORRELATION_FACTORS.MDL_assets: MDL distiller generates additional shader variants (late discovery, line 857)
CORRELATION_FACTORS.pedestrian_hair_assets: Hair materials (M_DHair_MASTER) have high permutation count due to hair shading model variants

UNEXPECTED_SHADER_SCOPE_DETAIL: PCD3D_ES31 shader platform adds ~33% more shader permutations (1 of 3 platforms) for materials that will NEVER run on ES3.1 in WindowsNoEditor runtime. This is pure waste.
